parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.operation === 'publish' ? { jobId: 'reach-tiktok_personal-' + $execution.id, manifestId: $json.manifestId, digest: $json.digest, mode: $json.mode, ownerConfirmed: $json.ownerConfirmed, target: 'tiktok_personal' } : $json.operation === 'login' ? { jobId: 'reach-tiktok_personal-' + $execution.id, target: 'tiktok_personal' } : $json.operation === 'inspect' ? { jobId: 'reach-tiktok_personal-' + $execution.id, target: 'tiktok_personal', view: $json.view } : $json.operation === 'reconcile' ? { jobId: 'reach-tiktok_personal-' + $execution.id, runId: $json.runId, itemId: $json.itemId, target: 'tiktok_personal', ...($json.url ? { url: $json.url } : {}) } : ['stop', 'close'].includes($json.operation) ? { runId: $json.runId, target: 'tiktok_personal' } : { jobId: 'reach-tiktok_personal-' + $execution.id, target: 'tiktok_personal', contentKind: 'reach' }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const value = $input.first().json; const result = value.result ?? value; const action = result.reason === 'existing_profile_in_use' ? 'The existing TikTok Personal browser profile is already open. Bring that window forward; do not launch another browser or profile.' : result.status === 'review_required' && result.accountReadiness?.some(item => item.identityVerified === false) ? 'Reach manifest ready for review, but this account has no calibrated identity selector. Do not publish until the existing account profile has been checked and its UI controls are configured.' : result.status === 'review_required' ? 'TikTok Personal Reach manifest ready. Review the exact pack, every ordered image, copy, account, destination and visibility; approve this digest only after review.' : result.status === 'awaiting_owner_login' ? 'Finish login in the existing TikTok Personal browser profile, then run plan again. No new browser profile is needed.' : result.status === 'caught_up' && result.progress?.some(item => item.unresolved > 0) ? 'No eligible TikTok Personal Reach packs. Review unresolved or unsupported deliveries in the report before trying again.' : result.status === 'caught_up' || result.status === 'completed' || result.status === 'synchronized' ? 'Read the TikTok Personal Reach progress and receipt report. This workflow never switches accounts.' : 'Inspect the stop reason and reconcile the exact TikTok Personal Reach item before any retry.'; return [{ json: { ...value, action } }];
